extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants, grantees, institutional research administrators, and research program staff
extracted.subtask_description: Table of contents for the NIH Grants Policy Statement (10/98), listing the policies, terms, conditions, and procedural requirements that govern NIH grants and cooperative agreements (eligibility, application, review, funding, cost allowability, public policy compliance, reporting, intellectual property, and closeout).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability / Effective period
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH Grants Policy Statement (10/01/1998) - Effective for all NIH grants and cooperative agreements with budget periods beginning on October 1, 1998 through February 28, 2001.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See subsequent NIHGPS versions for later budget periods (03/01 NIHGPS and 12/03 NIHGPS).

rubrics_metrics.name: Glossary / Definitions / Acronyms
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide definitions, glossary terms, and acronyms used in the NIH Grants Policy Statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: The National Institutes of Health as a grant-making organization
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation of NIH roles and the organizational context for grants administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Roles and Responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines roles and responsibilities of NIH, HHS staff, and grantee staff in grants administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH and HHS Staff
rubrics_metrics.description: Delineation of NIH and HHS staff responsibilities relevant to grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grantee Staff
rubrics_metrics.description: Delineation of grantee institution staff responsibilities for managing NIH awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application and Review Processes
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies and procedures governing how applications are submitted and reviewed by NIH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support Mechanisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Descriptions of the types of grant and cooperative agreement support mechanisms available from NIH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility criteria for applicants and institutions to apply for NIH grants (appears in multiple parts for different programs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions and rules for competing, noncompeting, renewal, supplemental, and other application types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding Opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about NIH funding opportunity announcements and how they relate to eligibility and application content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and requirements for preparing and submitting grant applications to NIH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Forms / Table of Required Forms for Competing Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: List of required application forms and documentation for competing applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Receipt Points and Deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Designated submission/receipt points and application deadlines that applicants must meet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal Implication of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal consequences and responsibilities associated with submission of an application to NIH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality of Information (Proprietary Information)
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies on confidentiality and handling of proprietary information contained in applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Peer Review Process (Initial Review)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and criteria for NIH's initial peer review of applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Advisory Council or Board Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Subsequent advisory council/board review steps following initial peer review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals of Initial Scientific Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Processes and grounds for appealing initial scientific review outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disposition of Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies on how NIH disposes of applications (e.g., return without review, triage, funding decisions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sources of Information About NIH's Grants Process and Programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Where applicants and grantees can obtain information about NIH grants processes and programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completing the Preaward Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Steps and requirements to complete prior to award issuance (administrative and eligibility checks).

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles that guide NIH decisions about awarding funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Analysis and Assessment of Management Systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for cost analysis and evaluation of grantee financial/management systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of Terms and Conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary of the standard terms and conditions that will appear on NIH awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Policy Requirements and Objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement and list of public policy requirements and objectives that apply to NIH awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethical and Safe Conduct in Science and Organizational Operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Expectations and requirements for ethical conduct and safety in NIH-funded research and operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict of Interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies governing conflicts of interest for investigators and institutions receiving NIH funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Debarment and Suspension
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules regarding debarred or suspended entities and individuals and their ineligibility to receive NIH funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drug-Free Workplace
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement for maintaining a drug-free workplace under NIH awards where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Health and Safety Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicable health and safety policies for NIH-funded activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation on Use of Funds for Promotion or Legalization of Controlled Substances
rubrics_metrics.description: Restrictions on using NIH funds to promote or legalize controlled substances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lobbying
rubrics_metrics.description: Prohibitions and disclosure requirements concerning lobbying activities when NIH funds are used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Misconduct in Science
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies and procedures for handling allegations and findings of scientific misconduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nondelinquency on Federal Debt
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that grantees not be delinquent on federal debt obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recombinant DNA and Institutional Biosafety Committees
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements related to recombinant DNA research and IBC oversight for NIH-funded projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restriction on Distribution of Sterile Needles
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy restrictions concerning distribution of sterile needles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seat Belt Use
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy encouraging or requiring seat belt use for NIH-funded activities where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Smoke-Free Workplace
rubrics_metrics.description: Expectation or requirement for a smoke-free workplace under NIH awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements Affecting Rights and Welfare of Individuals as Research Subjects, Patients, or Recipients of Services
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies that protect rights and welfare of human research subjects, patients, and service recipients.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ban on Human Embryo Research and Cloning
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy prohibiting certain human embryo research and cloning activities under NIH funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality of Patient Records
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for maintaining confidentiality of patient records in NIH-funded research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Controlled Substances (as research-related policy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies governing use and handling of controlled substances in NIH-funded work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for protection of human subjects, including review and approval processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigational New Drug Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements related to IND applications when NIH-funded research involves investigational drugs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pro-Children Act of 1994
rubrics_metrics.description: Compliance requirements with the Pro-Children Act where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protection of Research Subjects' Identity
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies to protect the identity of research subjects in NIH-funded studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research on Transplantation of Fetal Tissue
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific policies applicable to NIH-funded research on fetal tissue transplantation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Animal Welfare / Vertebrate Animals
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for the humane care and use of vertebrate animals in NIH-funded research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Inclusiveness in Research Design
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies requiring consideration of inclusion in study design (e.g., sex/gender, race/ethnicity, age).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Women and Minorities as Subjects in Clinical Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific policies requiring inclusion of women and minorities in clinical research unless justified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Children as Subjects in Clinical Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies regarding when and how children should be included in clinical research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civil Rights / Anti-Discrimination Statutes
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicability of Civil Rights Act of 1964, Age Discrimination Act of 1975, Education Amendments of 1972, Rehabilitation Act of 1973, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental Impact and Construction-related Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Environmental and other requirements related to acquisition, alteration, renovation, and construction of facilities with NIH funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of Information / Acknowledgment of Federal Funding / FOIA / Privacy Act
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on availability of information, acknowledgment of federal funding, Freedom of Information Act, and Privacy Act obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metric System
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to use the metric system where applicable in NIH-funded projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military Recruiting and ROTC Program Access
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies regarding military recruiting and Reserve Officer Training Corps program access to institutions of higher education.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Grant Award
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH's official notice of grant award and its implications for funding and project start.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding / Budget / Additional Terms and Conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies governing award funding, budgeting, and additional award-specific terms and conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment Mechanisms (SMARTLINK II/ACH / CASHLINE/ACH / Monthly Cash Request)
rubrics_metrics.description: Payment systems and procedures for NIH grant payments and cash management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interest Earned on Advances of Grant Funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies governing interest earned on advanced NIH grant funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Considerations / The Cost Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: Cost principles that govern allowability, reasonableness, and allocability of costs on NIH awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct Costs and Facilities and Administrative (Indirect) Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for charging direct costs versus facilities & administrative (indirect) costs to NIH grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Transfers, Overruns, and Accelerated and Delayed Expenditures
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies on transferring costs between grants, handling overruns, and timing of expenditures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allocation of Costs and Closely Related Work
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on allocating costs among projects and distinguishing closely related work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicable Credits
rubrics_metrics.description: Treatment of credits (e.g., rebates, refunds) that reduce allowable costs on NIH awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Services Provided by Affiliated Organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Allowability and treatment of services provided by affiliated organizations to grantees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of Costs/Activities / Selected Items of Cost
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed rules and examples for which costs and activities are allowable or unallowable under NIH awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative Requirements (Changes in Project and Budget / Prior Approval Requirements / Expanded Authorities / Requests for Approval)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for requesting NIH prior approval for certain changes and the scope of expanded authorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Noncompeting Continuation Awards / Streamlined Noncompeting Award Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies and procedures for continuation funding and streamlined processing of noncompeting awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of Research Results: Publications and Intellectual Property Rights, Including Unique Research Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies on publication, data rights, copyrights, and sharing of unique research resources from NIH-funded research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rights in Data (Publication and Copyrighting) / Unique Research Resources / Inventions and Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific policies governing data rights, publication, ownership and reporting of inventions and patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Management System Standards / Property Management System Standards / Procurement System Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards required for grantee financial, property, and procurement management systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Income / Sale of Real Property, Equipment, and Supplies / Reporting of Program Income
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for program income generation, sales/disposition of property, and reporting requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Royalties and Licensing Fees from Copyrights, Inventions, and Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies on treatment and reporting of royalties and licensing fees resulting from NIH-funded work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Real Property / Equipment and Supplies / Exempt and Nonexempt Property / Revocable License
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for acquisition, use, management, and disposition of real and tangible personal property purchased with NIH funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: General Procurement Requirements / Approval Requirements / Contracting With Small Businesses, Minority-Owned Firms, and Women's Business Enterprises
rubrics_metrics.description: Procurement policies including approval thresholds and requirements for contracting with small and disadvantaged businesses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring / Reporting (Progress Reports / Financial Reports / Unobligated Balances and Actual Expenditures)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting obligations for progress, financial status, and reporting on unobligated balances and expenditures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invention Reporting / Final Invention Statement and Certification
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for reporting inventions during and at closeout of NIH-funded projects, including final certifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report to the Office of Research Integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligations to report certain findings or allegations to ORI as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lobbying Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure requirements related to lobbying activities for NIH-funded entities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record Retention and Access
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for retaining records and providing access to records related to NIH awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit
rubrics_metrics.description: Audit requirements and standards applicable to NIH grantees and award oversight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enforcement Actions (Modification / Suspension / Termination / Withholding of Support / Other Enforcement Actions / Recovery of Funds / Debt Collection)
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and procedures under which NIH may enforce award terms, recover funds, or take other actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Closeout (Final Reports / Final Financial Status Report / Final Progress Report / Final Invention Statement and Certification)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures for closeout of NIH awards, including submission of final reports and certifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant Appeals Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for appealing certain NIH administrative decisions regarding grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Construction Grants: Eligibility / Review and Approval / Public Policy Requirements and Objectives (NEPA, Public Disclosure, Flood Insurance, Historic Properties)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific policies and requirements for NIH construction grants, including environmental and disclosure requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability and Procurement Requirements for Construction Services Under NIH Construction Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Allowable costs and procurement rules specific to construction services under NIH construction funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equal Employment Opportunity, Labor Standards, Contract Work Hours and Safety Standards, Liquidated Damages
rubrics_metrics.description: Labor and employment standards that apply to construction and certain grants-related contracts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alteration and Renovation Projects Under Nonconstruction Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies for alteration and renovation projects funded under nonconstruction grants, including real property management standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Research Service Awards (NRSA): Applicability / Eligibility / Degree Requirements / Citizenship / Sponsorship / Payment / Financial Provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive policies governing individual and institutional NRSA training awards (fellowships and training grants), including eligibility, stipends, benefits, reporting, payback, and other terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes subsections on predoctoral, postdoctoral, senior fellows, citizenship, foreign sponsorship, NIH employees, trainees, stipends, tuition, reporting, leave, termination, publications, patents, and human subjects/animal welfare compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payback Reporting Requirements for NRSA Recipients
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies on service and financial payback obligations, timing, extensions, waivers, and certification for NRSA recipients.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support of Scientific Meetings (Conference Grants): Definitions / Eligibility / Application / Allowability of Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies and requirements for NIH support of scientific meetings and conferences, including allowable costs and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium Agreements: Administrative and Other Requirements / Public Policy Requirements / Application of Cost Principles / Tangible Personal Property
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and requirements for consortium/subaward agreements under NIH awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards to Foreign Institutions, International Organizations, and Domestic Grants with Substantial Foreign Components: Eligibility / Review / Funding and Payment / Allowability of Costs / Administrative Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Special rules and considerations for NIH awards involving foreign institutions or substantial foreign components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants to Federal Institutions and Payments to (or on Behalf of) Federal Employees Under Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies governing awards to federal institutions and payments related to federal employees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants to For-Profit Organizations: Eligibility / Allowability of Costs / Cost Principles / Profit or Fee / IR&D Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules that apply to for-profit organizations receiving NIH grant funds, including treatment of profit/fee and indirect costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program-specific: Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) and Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) Programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility, public policy requirements, allowability of costs and fee/profit, indirect costs, market research, program income, and IP rights specific to SBIR/STTR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Patient Care Costs: Definitions / Policy / Allowability / Computation
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies and computations for allowable patient care costs in NIH-funded clinical research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grantees / Consortium Participants / Contractors under Grants: Financial Responsibilities / Program Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Responsibilities and programmatic requirements for grantees and consortium participants or contractors under NIH grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Part IV: Points of Contact / Master List of Links to Documents External to the NIHGPS
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact information and links to external documents relevant to NIH grants policy compliance.
